title: Configuration files and scripts for the OpenWQ functional unit tests
description:
Configuration files, host-model inputs, and analytical-solution scripts for the functional unit tests of OpenWQ coupled to SUMMA and mizuRoute: batch reaction networks (Tests 1-6) and advection-dispersion with and without first-order decay in a SUMMA soil column and a mizuRoute river network (Tests 7-10). These are the test cases reported in Costa et al. (submitted to the Journal of Advances in Modeling Earth Systems), Appendix C.

Requires OpenWQ v1.1.1 or later (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23183928), SUMMA (ue-hydro/summa_ashleymedin, develop) and mizuRoute (ue-hydro/mizuRoute_ESCOMP_withOpenWQlink, main, commit a181364 or later). See README.md for build and run instructions and expected results.
